description: This file defines the Nios II specific kernel interface, including inline functions for interrupt control, exception handling, and CPU cycle counters, as well as data structures and macros related to the Nios II architecture.

methods.name: arch_irq_lock
methods.description: Inline function to disable interrupts and return previous interrupt state.

methods.name: arch_irq_unlock
methods.description: Inline function to restore interrupt state based on saved key.

methods.name: arch_irq_unlocked
methods.description: Inline function to check if interrupts are unlocked.

methods.name: arch_k_cycle_get_32
methods.description: Returns the current CPU cycle count as a 32-bit value.

methods.name: arch_k_cycle_get_64
methods.description: Returns the current CPU cycle count as a 64-bit value.
